About Royal Home Health Care

Committed to our patients and their families.

We are a licensed, Medicare-certified home health agency based in Van Nuys, California, bringing attentive clinical care to families across Los Angeles, Ventura, San Bernardino, and Orange Counties.

Medicare-Certified Home Health Agency

Our mission

Quality care by compassionate hearts.

Our goal is straightforward: to help you or your loved one recover, stay safe, and feel comfortable in the place you know best. We do that through unhurried clinical visits, honest communication, and genuine respect for every family we meet.

Coming home from a hospital or rehab stay is a big moment, and having the right support in those first few weeks makes all the difference. Steady care at home helps prevent avoidable trips back to the emergency room and lets you heal in your own bed, surrounded by family.

Everything we do starts with your own doctor. Your physician directs your medical plan, and our team brings that plan to life in your living room while keeping your doctor updated along the way.

What guides us

Six commitments we make to every family.

  • Genuine compassion

    We care for every patient the way we would want our own parents and grandparents cared for, with patience, dignity, and kindness.

  • Clinical excellence

    Experienced, licensed nurses and therapists who follow your doctor's orders and take pride in getting the details right.

  • Family partnership

    Families are part of the care team. We take the time to teach, listen, and keep you in the loop at every visit.

  • Seamless coordination

    One shared plan and one connected team, with nursing, therapy, aides, and medical supplies working alongside your doctor.

  • Everyday safety

    Careful medication reviews, fall prevention, sterile technique, and clear guidance on when to call us.

  • Respect for every person

    We proudly care for families of every background across Southern California and adapt how we communicate to fit your needs.

Your care team

The people who come to your door.

Every member of your team works from the same plan of care, signed by your physician.

  • Registered nurses

    Evaluate your health, provide hands-on clinical care, teach your family, and coordinate directly with your physician.

  • Certified home health aides

    Assist with warm showers, grooming, dressing, and safe mobility under the supervision of a registered nurse.

  • Physical, occupational & speech therapists

    Licensed local therapy partners coordinated by Royal as part of your care plan.

  • Medical social workers

    Help families navigate community programs, counseling, and long-term care planning.

How care begins

  1. 01

    Step 1: Quick referral

    Your doctor, hospital, or clinic sends a referral over, or you call us directly and we reach out to your doctor's office for you.

  2. 02

    Step 2: Home nurse visit

    One of our registered nurses comes to your home, listens to how you are feeling, and goes over your medications and care needs.

  3. 03

    Step 3: Your personal care plan

    Together with your physician, we set up a plan that fits your life, including the right services, visit schedule, and recovery goals.

  4. 04

    Step 4: Care that adjusts with you

    Your team visits on schedule, shows your family how to help, keeps your doctor updated, and adjusts your visits as you get stronger.
